style.checked_requirement: Citron/aubergine lithographic world, restrained burnt-orange touch points, adult reach/support gestures, chunky real plant forms, sparse directional hatch and overprinted silhouettes.
observations: Both plants now have aubergine/mulberry/wine faces, citron negative veins and directional strokes.
Warm orange hands and right pot join plum plants/pots/table; strongly saturated citron field and precise aubergine title form a cohesive print palette.
Grain stays within illustration surfaces; type remains sharply separate.

ratio.policy: Permitted nearest-integer one-edge rounding; returned bytes not resized.

observations: Compact oval-leaf branching plant and tall broad/fenestrated-leaf plant differ substantially in habit and scale.
Upper adult hand touches/holds compact plant leaf; right adult hand supports the orange pot; common angled tabletop links the comparison.
The image occupies and shapes the right half with content-bearing contact and botanical form, rather than serving as a tiny ornament.
Korean syllable proportions/counters and word starts are stable; all twelve entries read with meaningful word spaces.
At 720 the four-line paragraph and practical copy remain high contrast and sequentially readable; English/URL are the smallest roles.
Title/subtitle/place have heavier sans weight than mature regular explanatory/access/care text.
Title is immediately recognisable in thumbnail, balanced by reaching hand and contrasting plant masses.
Same left start joins eyebrow/title/companion/subtitle/whole paragraph, then date/hours/place with a small clear gap.
Access/care and invitation/URL continue the rail with modest group gaps; no corner search or image/text overlap.
Illustrated branch direction, broad-leaf crop, active gestures and oblique table supply the whole poster rhythm; citron is an active print ground.
Upper adult thumb/index touch an intact oval leaf, with separated finger boundaries and stems running into soil.
Right adult hand wraps the pot front/side; rim/soil/stem contact and pot/table footing remain visible.
The grip is on the pot side below its rim rather than the initial prompt's suggested thumb-on-rim detail; the requested support at the pot edge still reads.
Layered ink grain and hatch vary with leaf/pot/table surface while fine leaf veins remain intact.
Controlled printed contours; no floating pot, broken stem connection or extra invented print observed.
Compared with initial the illustration is slightly enlarged/shifted; footer sits closer to lower edge but remains within the canvas.

observations.observation: Aubergine/wine overprint and citron negative veins replace green, retaining real plant habit and contacts.
Complete ranges, long midline bars, dot and paired colons visible; range spacing tighter than initial.
Four-line paragraph and all practical groups readable along same optical start; lower URL has a narrower bottom margin than initial.
Title dominates left upper group; adult hand reach and two distinctly scaled plant silhouettes balance it across citron field.

residuals.limit: Full copy is too small for comfortable reading at thumbnail; that view supports hierarchy only.
Bottom margin is narrower than initial, though text remains unclipped in native/720 views.

selected_reason: Repair retains complete read copy, clear hierarchy and both meaningful plant/hand contacts while more directly achieving the assigned aubergine ink identity and compact range typography. No further native correction is justified by the inspected result.
